name: Redline History Diff
blurb: every note that landed on the same area over time, with outcomes
intro: Groups the app's redline notes by the area they were drawn on - the same model and part, or else a camera target within a radius - and lists each area's notes in time order with their outcome. A note that follows an applied fix on the same spot counts as 'came back': the first fix did not settle it.

inputs.label: Nearby within
inputs.help: Camera targets closer than this count as one spot.

inputs.label: Timeline of area
inputs.placeholder: part or model name; empty = the most marked

examples.title: The base part only, by camera

usage: Pass `notes` as a JSON array of revision notes (the app's GET /api/revisions and /api/revisions?archived=true: id, created_at, kind, model, part, status, summary or comment, camera.target or target). `by` chooses what counts as the same area (auto, part, place, model), `radius` in mm joins nearby camera targets, `min` is the repeat threshold and `area` picks the timeline to show. It returns the areas marked repeatedly with applied/rejected/open counts and 'came back' notes (a new note after an applied fix), plus one area's timeline with note IDs. Use it before changing a spot to see what was already tried there.
sources: Grouping by camera target within a radius: rule of thumb (the orbit camera is centred on what is being marked)
